accademia-scala-scarlatti-conservatorio-.title: The Accademia della Scala orchestra opens the Scarlatti season at the Conservatory
accademia-scala-scarlatti-conservatorio-.blurb: The young players of the Teatro alla Scala Academy, with conductor Marco Angius and pianist Ruben Micieli, play Mozart, Beethoven's Second Piano Concerto and Stravinsky's Dumbarton Oaks. Tickets are €20, or €12 if you're under 30.

ad-1656-peste-palazzo-diomede-carafa-202.title: A.D. 1656, the Naples plague in a video installation at Palazzo Carafa
ad-1656-peste-palazzo-diomede-carafa-202.blurb: A friar's chronicle of the 1656 plague and Micco Spadaro's painting of piazza Mercatello become an immersive story, inside a palazzo on Spaccanapoli. Entry is in groups of 25 at 9.30am, 10.30am and 11.30am, Monday to Friday, plus special openings on 3 and 4 October.
ad-1656-peste-palazzo-diomede-carafa-202.place: Palazzo Diomede Carafa, via San Biagio dei Librai 121

aiello-tour-club-casa-della-musica-2026.title: Aiello, club tour at the Casa della Musica
aiello-tour-club-casa-della-musica-2026.blurb: The Italian singer-songwriter Aiello brings the Naples date of his tour to the Casa della Musica, in a smaller format than the arenas. A good pick if you follow the newer wave of Italian songwriters.

americas-cup-napoli-2026.title: America’s Cup in Naples: preliminary regattas in the bay
americas-cup-napoli-2026.blurb: Nine AC40 boats racing in the bay, Luna Rossa included: more fleet races on Saturday from 2pm, then on Sunday the last ones and the final match race between the top two. The Race Village on the Rotonda Diaz opens at 11am, free to enter, with big screens along the seafront; for a view from above, head to via Petrarca or via Orazio. Also live on Rai 2.
americas-cup-napoli-2026.place: Race Village at the Rotonda Diaz, Lungomare Caracciolo

amleto-2-filippo-timi-bellini-2026.title: Amleto² with Filippo Timi at the Bellini
amleto-2-filippo-timi-bellini-2026.blurb: Filippo Timi brings his reworking of Hamlet to the Bellini's main stage, eighty-five minutes long, in Italian. Five days of performances, so there's room to pick the date that suits you.

anita-rachvelishvili-san-carlo-2026.title: Anita Rachvelishvili in recital at the Teatro di San Carlo
anita-rachvelishvili-san-carlo-2026.blurb: The Georgian mezzo-soprano, with Vincenzo Scalera at the piano, sings songs by Tchaikovsky and Rachmaninov, Tosti and De Falla, plus "Stride la vampa" from Il Trovatore. On a budget, there are listening-only places at €15, and the balcony starts at €20.

anna-tatangelo-casa-della-musica-2026.title: Anna Tatangelo at the Casa della Musica
anna-tatangelo-casa-della-musica-2026.blurb: Anna Tatangelo in concert in the hall of the Palapartenope complex, a rescheduled date. If you already had a ticket, it's still valid.

arriva-lucilla-palapartenope-2026.title: Arriva Lucilla, a family show at the Palapartenope
arriva-lucilla-palapartenope-2026.blurb: A family show timed for younger children, starting as early as 6pm. If you have little ones, get there with time to spare: family shows fill up fast.

artecinema-2026.title: Artecinema, the festival of films on contemporary art
artecinema-2026.blurb: Four days of documentaries about contemporary artists and architects, opening at the San Carlo with screenings at the Augusteo. The Augusteo is free; for the San Carlo, tickets are on Vivaticket.
artecinema-2026.place: Teatro Augusteo and Teatro di San Carlo

avion-travel-nos-cortile-statue-2026.title: Avion Travel and the Nuova Orchestra Scarlatti in the Cortile delle Statue
avion-travel-nos-cortile-statue-2026.blurb: The Italian band Avion Travel with the orchestra conducted by Angelo Valori, moving between Paisiello, Piazzolla and their own songs in symphonic dress. It's the last night of the UniMusic festival, with €10 tickets online or at the box office an hour before.
avion-travel-nos-cortile-statue-2026.place: Cortile delle Statue (Courtyard of the Statues), Università Federico II

balance-trio-conservatorio-2026.title: Balance Trio, Piazzolla and friends at the Conservatorio San Pietro a Majella
balance-trio-conservatorio-2026.blurb: Saxophone, cello and piano for music by Elizondo, Glinka and Piazzolla. A free 6pm concert, nicely timed before an aperitivo in piazza Bellini.
balance-trio-conservatorio-2026.place: Conservatorio San Pietro a Majella, Sala Scarlatti

ballata-dei-gigli-di-barra-2026.title: Ballata dei Gigli di Barra, the dancing towers festival
ballata-dei-gigli-di-barra-2026.blurb: Eight towers of wood and papier-mâché, more than 25 metres tall, dance on the shoulders of hundreds of bearers from morning until late at night. Go in the evening, when the crews (paranze) compete with music, and on Monday 28 from 8pm it's the turn of the women's and children's towers.
ballata-dei-gigli-di-barra-2026.place: Streets and squares of the Barra district

barocco-italiano-florio-porta-del-parco-.title: Antonio Florio and the Italian Baroque at the Auditorium Porta del Parco
barocco-italiano-florio-porta-del-parco-.blurb: Antonio Florio conducts the Ensemble ScarlattiLab in concertos by Scarlatti, Vivaldi, Valentini and Corelli, with Giacomo Lapegna on bassoon. A Saturday afternoon in Bagnoli, part of the Musica Urbana series.

basso-napoletano-galleria-toledo-2026.title: Basso napoletano by Marco Sgrosso at Galleria Toledo
basso-napoletano-galleria-toledo-2026.blurb: Voice and double bass, Marco Sgrosso and Felice Del Gaudio, in a jam session of Neapolitan words from Eduardo onwards. It opens Galleria Toledo's 35th anniversary season, Sunday at 6pm.

beethoven-kreutzer-san-carlo-2026.title: Beethoven and Kreutzer septets at the Teatro di San Carlo
beethoven-kreutzer-san-carlo-2026.blurb: Seven musicians from the San Carlo orchestra set Beethoven's Septet op. 20 against Conradin Kreutzer's, in the same key and for the same instruments. An hour of chamber music on a Sunday afternoon, €18 for any seat.

biagio-antonacci-teatro-grande-pompei-20.title: Biagio Antonacci Unplugged at the Teatro Grande in Pompeii
biagio-antonacci-teatro-grande-pompei-20.blurb: Ten acoustic nights in the ancient theatre inside the excavations: 22, 23, 25, 26, 27, 29 and 30 September, then 2, 3 and 4 October. The Italian singer-songwriter's best-known songs, stripped right back, with the audience just a few metres away.
biagio-antonacci-teatro-grande-pompei-20.place: Teatro Grande, Parco Archeologico di Pompei

biasiucci-archetipi-reggia-caserta-2026.title: Archetipi, Antonio Biasiucci at the Reggia di Caserta
biasiucci-archetipi-reggia-caserta-2026.blurb: Over 300 photographs and installations by Antonio Biasiucci, from steam to bread to volcanoes, along the Gran Galleria of the Royal Apartments. It's included in the Reggia ticket, and the palace is closed on Tuesdays.

bit-fest-sound-innovation-2026.title: BIT FEST: Sound Innovation at the Bellini
bit-fest-sound-innovation-2026.blurb: Two days about sound as a contemporary language, with installations and live performances at the Teatro Bellini. If experimental sound interests you more than the usual theatre programme, it makes a change.

bolero-balletto-san-carlo-2026.title: Boléro, a ballet evening at the San Carlo
bolero-balletto-san-carlo-2026.blurb: Three pieces in one evening: The Rite of Spring, Rachmaninov's Preludes and Béjart's Boléro to Ravel. Five dates between 5 and 10 November, a good way into contemporary dance without a dull minute. The Boléro closes the night and is worth the ticket on its own.

bosco-in-rosa-capodimonte-2026.title: Bosco in Rosa: a 4 km walk at Capodimonte for the Santobono hospital
bosco-in-rosa-capodimonte-2026.blurb: Four kilometres along the avenues of the royal park, at your own pace, in a pink T-shirt: the proceeds go to the Santobono children's hospital. Fine for families and pushchairs.

brunori-sas-tuttobrunori-augusteo-2026.title: Brunori Sas, “Tuttobrunori”, at the Augusteo
brunori-sas-tuttobrunori-augusteo-2026.blurb: The Italian songwriter Brunori Sas goes back over his whole career in one show, from the first independent records to the chart hits. A nice ticket to give someone who's followed him for years. Get there in good time: his concerts start on the dot.

buccirosso-qualcosa-e-andato-storto-sann.title: Qualcosa è andato storto by Carlo Buccirosso at the Teatro Sannazaro
buccirosso-qualcosa-e-andato-storto-sann.blurb: Carlo Buccirosso writes, directs and plays a small-town lawyer swept up in the quarrels of his entire extended family. Four performances, Sunday at 6pm.

cafe-chantant-sannazaro-ottobre-2026.title: Café Chantant My World by Lara Sansone at the Teatro Sannazaro
cafe-chantant-sannazaro-ottobre-2026.blurb: Lara Sansone's show with the Sannazaro's orchestra and dancers, comic sketches and songs from Naples' belle époque. Only three nights in October, then it's back around Christmas.

calici-e-jazz-luna-piena-vesuvio-2026.title: Wine and jazz under the full moon in the vineyards of Vesuvius
calici-e-jazz-luna-piena-vesuvio-2026.blurb: A walk through the vines with the agronomists, three wines to taste, a trail of local dishes, live jazz and the full moon through a telescope. If it rains, it moves indoors. The reduced price is for non-drinkers and young people aged 6 to 17.

campagna-amica-piazza-bovio-domenica-202.title: Campagna Amica farmers’ market in piazza Bovio, every Sunday
campagna-amica-piazza-bovio-domenica-202.blurb: On Sundays local producers set up their stalls in front of the old Stock Exchange, a short walk from the port and the University. You will find mozzarella and other dairy, vegetables from the surrounding countryside, pulses and preserves, and the Università metro stop is right there.

campagna-amica-piazza-mercadante-sabato-.blurb: Every Saturday, Coldiretti farmers set up their stalls in piazza Mercadante: seasonal fruit and veg, buffalo mozzarella, cured meats, honey, wine and wood-fired bread. Bring a big bag, and once autumn arrives try the chestnuts and friarielli, the slightly bitter local greens.

campagna-amica-posillipo-sabato-2026-09-.blurb: On Saturday mornings the little square in Posillipo fills with stalls run by Campania farmers, selling vegetables, cheese, olive oil and baked sweets. After your shopping, walk down towards Marechiaro for a coffee with a sea view.

campanella-schubert-conservatorio-2026.title: Michele Campanella plays Schubert for the Premio San Pietro a Majella
campanella-schubert-conservatorio-2026.blurb: The Neapolitan pianist receives the award for the Conservatorio's bicentenary and plays Schubert. It's the most anticipated evening of the autumn series, with free entry until places run out.
campanella-schubert-conservatorio-2026.place: Sala Scarlatti, Conservatorio San Pietro a Majella, via San Pietro a Majella 35

campania-libri-festival-2026.title: Campania Libri Festival, at Palazzo Reale and the Biblioteca Nazionale
campania-libri-festival-2026.blurb: Four days of talks with authors and publishers, more than 250 events, with a tribute to Roberto De Simone. Entry is free but the programme is packed: pick two or three talks in advance rather than trying to see everything. Mostly in Italian, and a good chance to see writers in person without buying a ticket.
campania-libri-festival-2026.place: Palazzo Reale and Biblioteca Nazionale Vittorio Emanuele III

cassius-duel-club-2026.title: Cassius at the Duel Club
cassius-duel-club-2026.blurb: The French touch of Cassius, the only Italian stop on a tour that takes in Dublin, London and Manchester. Doors at 9.30pm and limited capacity.

classical-world-music-piscinola-2026.title: Classical World Music inside Piscinola-Scampia metro station
classical-world-music-piscinola-2026.blurb: The Nuova Orchestra Scarlatti, conducted by Gaetano Russo, and singer Rossella Costa play everything from Rossini to pop inside the Line 1 metro station. Free entry, part of the Fiori musicali per le periferie series that takes music to the city's outskirts.

clerici-krylov-san-carlo-2026.title: Sergej Krylov plays Paganini at the Teatro di San Carlo
clerici-krylov-san-carlo-2026.blurb: The violinist Sergej Krylov takes on Paganini's Concerto No. 1, then Umberto Clerici conducts Schubert's Sixth. A Wednesday concert, an hour and a half without an interval, with listening-only places at €15.

colpi-di-scena-blues-noir-2026.title: Blues Noir at the Centro Direzionale, part of Colpi di Scena
colpi-di-scena-blues-noir-2026.blurb: Paolo Cresta tells the dark legends of the blues with a jazz trio, outdoors among the skyscrapers. It's free, but you need to book on Eventbrite.
colpi-di-scena-blues-noir-2026.place: Arena and Amphitheatre of the Centro Direzionale, Isola E2

colpi-di-scena-sant-anna-alle-paludi-202.title: Colpi di Scena at Sant'Anna alle Paludi: Oracoli Napoli and Il giorno dei morti
colpi-di-scena-sant-anna-alle-paludi-202.blurb: On Saturday an immersive performance about the mysteries of Partenope, the city's ancient siren, and on Sunday Maurizio de Giovanni's noir with Commissario Ricciardi brought to the stage. Two evenings in a little-known church near the station, free with booking on Eventbrite.
colpi-di-scena-sant-anna-alle-paludi-202.place: Chiesa di Sant'Anna alle Paludi, corso Arnaldo Lucci 124

corrado-augias-il-mio-900-augusteo-2026.title: Corrado Augias, “Il mio ’900”, at the Augusteo
corrado-augias-il-mio-900-augusteo-2026.blurb: The Italian writer and journalist Corrado Augias goes back over the 20th century his own way, through books, politics and personal memory, in a single evening, in Italian. Bring a notebook if you like picking up reading ideas. Pricey for the Augusteo, but that's the going rate for the big names in non-fiction.

creattiva-napoli-2026.title: Creattiva Napoli, the craft workshop fair
creattiva-napoli-2026.blurb: Four days of creative workshops, from sewing to DIY, at the Mostra d’Oltremare. Buy your ticket online and, on the first three days, arrive after 5pm, when the discounted happy hour kicks in. Under-tens go free, so it's a good idea for a weekend with children.

dada-fiabe-donna-ruvia-trianon-2026.title: Dadà, Le fiabe di donna Ruvia at the Teatro Trianon Viviani
dada-fiabe-donna-ruvia-trianon-2026.blurb: A concert-show by Dadà, a singer-songwriter from the new Neapolitan scene, somewhere between songwriting and contemporary sounds. Saturday at 9pm, Sunday afternoon at 6pm.

domenica-al-museo-napoli-ottobre-novembr.title: Domenica al Museo, free entry to Naples' state museums
domenica-al-museo-napoli-ottobre-novembr.blurb: On the first Sunday of the month, entry is free at the Archaeological Museum (MANN), Capodimonte, Palazzo Reale and the museums up in Vomero, no ticket to pay. Arrive at opening time or after 3pm, and if you can, pair San Martino with Castel Sant'Elmo, which are just a few steps apart.
domenica-al-museo-napoli-ottobre-novembr.place: MANN, Capodimonte, Palazzo Reale, Certosa di San Martino, Castel Sant'Elmo, Villa Floridiana, Museo Pignatelli, Girolamini

domenica-al-museo-napoli-ottobre-novembr.title: Domenica al Museo, free entry to Naples' state museums
domenica-al-museo-napoli-ottobre-novembr.blurb: On the first Sunday of the month, entry is free at the Archaeological Museum (MANN), Capodimonte, Palazzo Reale and the museums up in Vomero, no ticket to pay. Arrive at opening time or after 3pm, and if you can, pair San Martino with Castel Sant'Elmo, which are just a few steps apart.
domenica-al-museo-napoli-ottobre-novembr.place: MANN, Capodimonte, Palazzo Reale, Certosa di San Martino, Castel Sant'Elmo, Villa Floridiana, Museo Pignatelli, Girolamini

domenica-al-museo-pompei-ercolano-2026-1.title: Domenica al Museo at the Pompeii and Herculaneum excavations, free entry
domenica-al-museo-pompei-ercolano-2026-1.blurb: Pompeii and Herculaneum open for free on the first Sunday of the month, and at Herculaneum that also covers Villa Sora in Torre del Greco. It's the busiest day of the month: set off early on the Circumvesuviana train and start with Herculaneum, which is easy to see in half a day.
domenica-al-museo-pompei-ercolano-2026-1.time: from 9am, closing follows the park's seasonal hours
domenica-al-museo-pompei-ercolano-2026-1.place: Parco Archeologico di Pompei and Parco Archeologico di Ercolano

It's the busiest day of the month: set off early on the Circumvesuviana train and start with Herculaneum, which is easy to see in half a day.

donne-compositrici-donnaromita-2026.title: Women composers, sacred and profane, at Santa Maria Donnaromita
donne-compositrici-donnaromita-2026.blurb: A concert of music written by women inside a Baroque church that rarely opens, part of the Destinazione Donna series. Free, but booking on Eventbrite is compulsory.
donne-compositrici-donnaromita-2026.place: Chiesa di Santa Maria Donnaromita, via Paladino

dorazio-nuti-villa-pignatelli-2026.title: Francesco D'Orazio and Giampaolo Nuti at Villa Pignatelli
dorazio-nuti-villa-pignatelli-2026.blurb: Violin and piano on a Sunday morning, from Beethoven to Stravinsky, Schnittke and Pärt, in the museum's veranda on the Riviera di Chiaia. Book by phone with Maggio della Musica, there are 199 seats.

dove-liana-duel-club-2026.title: Dov'è Liana live at the Duel Club
dove-liana-duel-club-2026.blurb: The project that brought Italodance back to the dance floor, for a night of Mediterranean sounds at the club in Agnano. Tickets on Dice, best bought in advance.

drag-ring-priscilla-teatro-nuovo-2026.title: Drag Ring with Priscilla at the Teatro Nuovo
drag-ring-priscilla-teatro-nuovo-2026.blurb: Lip sync battles between drag queens hosted by Priscilla, with routines prepared to a playlist they receive in advance. One night only, Saturday at 9pm.

e-grande-essere-piccoli-teatro-dei-picco.title: È grande essere piccoli: circus, theatre and music at the Teatro dei Piccoli
e-grande-essere-piccoli-teatro-dei-picco.blurb: At weekends the theatre and gardens of the Mostra d'Oltremare fill up with soap bubbles, clowns, circus acts and concerts for children. Tickets are cheap and entry is until places run out, so get there a quarter of an hour early.
e-grande-essere-piccoli-teatro-dei-picco.place: Teatro dei Piccoli, Mostra d'Oltremare, viale Usodimare

emigranti-bellini-2026.title: Emigranti by Mrożek at the Teatro Bellini
emigranti-bellini-2026.blurb: Valerio Santoro and Claudio Casadio play the two emigrants shut in a basement in Sławomir Mrożek's play, directed by Leo Muscato. There's a Wednesday matinee at 5.30pm, handy if you'd rather not make it a late one.

est-festival-napoli-est-2026.title: EST, the East Naples arts festival with Di Leva and Lanzetta
est-festival-napoli-est-2026.blurb: Francesco Di Leva and Adriano Pantaleo's theatre brings funk, jazz and comedy to San Giovanni, closing with a reading by Peppe Lanzetta on 4 October. Everything is free with booking on Eventbrite, and it's an easy ride on the Circumvesuviana, the local train line.
est-festival-napoli-est-2026.place: NEST Napoli Est Teatro and Centro Asterix

fabrizio-moro-casa-della-musica-2026.title: Fabrizio Moro, Non ho paura di niente
fabrizio-moro-casa-della-musica-2026.blurb: The Italian singer-songwriter Fabrizio Moro in concert at the Casa della Musica, one flat ticket price of forty-nine euros. A more intimate format than the arenas, good if you'd rather listen up close.

festa-castagna-scala-2026.title: Chestnut festival (Festa della Castagna) in Scala
festa-castagna-scala-2026.blurb: Two weekends in the oldest village on the Amalfi Coast, above Ravello: chestnuts, cakes and mountain dishes with a sea view, now in its 49th year.

festa-dell-uva-oliveto-citra-2026.title: Grape festival (Festa dell’Uva) in Oliveto Citra
festa-dell-uva-oliveto-citra-2026.blurb: Three evenings of wine, decorated floats and country cooking in the Sele valley, now in its 52nd year. About an hour and twenty minutes from Naples by car.

festival-ethnos-donnalbina-2026.title: Festival Ethnos: four nights of world music at Santa Maria Donnalbina
festival-ethnos-donnalbina-2026.blurb: The world music festival comes into the city: on the 24th Ensemble Enerbia and Maria Mazzotta, on the 25th ZeroFolkDuo and Dal:um from Korea, on the 26th Constantinople with Ghalia Benali, on the 27th Raül Refree with Aida Tarrío. Concerts at 8.30pm and 9.30pm, on the 26th and 27th at 9pm.

fiabe-d-autunno-orto-botanico-2026.title: Fiabe d'Autunno, walking fairy-tale theatre at the Botanical Garden
fiabe-d-autunno-orto-botanico-2026.blurb: Every Saturday and Sunday morning the company I Teatrini leads children and parents through the trees inside a fairy tale, from the Pied Piper to Oz to the Ugly Duckling. Booking is compulsory, with a maximum of 80 children per show, and it's cancelled if it rains.

figlio-della-tempesta-trianon-2026.title: Il figlio della tempesta by Armando Punzo at the Teatro Trianon Viviani
figlio-della-tempesta-trianon-2026.blurb: Armando Punzo and Andrea Salvadori with the Compagnia della Fortezza, the group that has been making theatre inside Volterra prison for over thirty years. Two performances, Saturday evening and Sunday at 6pm.

filarmonica-calabria-cilea-conservatorio.title: The Orchestra Filarmonica della Calabria plays Cilea at the Conservatory
filarmonica-calabria-cilea-conservatorio.blurb: Filippo Arlia conducts the Calabrian orchestra, with Sergio Messina on violin and Francesco Mariozzi on cello, in an all-Francesco Cilea programme. Free entry, in the most beautiful hall of the Conservatory.
filarmonica-calabria-cilea-conservatorio.place: Conservatorio San Pietro a Majella, Sala Scarlatti

fratelli-de-filippo-rubini-diana-2026.title: I fratelli De Filippo by Sergio Rubini at the Teatro Diana
fratelli-de-filippo-rubini-diana-2026.blurb: Sergio Rubini stages Eduardo, Peppino and Titina, the famous Neapolitan theatre siblings, from Maurizio Giammusso's book, with Susy Del Giudice, Marianna Fontana and music by Nicola Piovani. Two weeks in Vomero, with a Wednesday matinee.

fratellina-piccolo-bellini-2026.title: Fratellina by Spiro Scimone at the Piccolo Bellini
fratellina-piccolo-bellini-2026.blurb: Scimone and Sframeli, the Messina duo behind Italy's home-grown theatre of the absurd, return with four actors and sets by Lino Fiorito. Wednesday's show is at 6pm, Saturday's at 7.30pm and Sunday's at 6.30pm.

frizza-kavakos-san-carlo-2026.title: Frizza and Kavakos at the Teatro di San Carlo
frizza-kavakos-san-carlo-2026.blurb: A symphony concert at the San Carlo with Riccardo Frizza conducting and Leonidas Kavakos as violin soloist. Arrive a quarter of an hour early for the ticket check: the hall fills up quickly for a programme like this.

fulminata-teresa-mannino-bellini-2026.title: Fulminata, at the Piccolo Bellini
fulminata-teresa-mannino-bellini-2026.blurb: Annagaia Marchioro takes the stage at the Piccolo Bellini in a monologue directed by Teresa Mannino, the portrait of a woman who won't give up. From 20 to 25 October, in Italian; it's a small hall, so book ahead. Recommended for a short, direct evening of theatre.

giochi-di-zucca-mostra-d-oltremare-2026.title: Giochi di Zucca, the pumpkin patch at the Mostra d'Oltremare
giochi-di-zucca-mostra-d-oltremare-2026.blurb: A month of pumpkin picking and autumn-themed games for children around the lake at the Mostra. At weekends it stays open until 9pm, and it's worth buying tickets online to skip the queue.
giochi-di-zucca-mostra-d-oltremare-2026.place: Laghetto Fasilides, Mostra d'Oltremare, viale Kennedy 64

giornata-del-caffe-gambrinus-2026.title: Coffee Day at the Gran Caffè Gambrinus
giornata-del-caffe-gambrinus-2026.blurb: In the Hall of Mirrors you can taste coffees from different countries and see old roasters, grinders and coffee pots. You need a free ticket, downloadable from the Gambrinus website.
giornata-del-caffe-gambrinus-2026.place: Gran Caffè Gambrinus, Salone degli Specchi, via Chiaia 1

giornate-fai-autunno-napoli-2026.title: Giornate FAI d’Autunno: sites usually closed open up in Naples and Campania
giornate-fai-autunno-napoli-2026.blurb: For one weekend, volunteers from FAI (Italy’s National Trust) open palaces, churches and gardens that stay shut the rest of the year, with short guided visits often led by students. Check the list as soon as it comes out and aim for the lesser-known places, where the queues are shorter.
giornate-fai-autunno-napoli-2026.place: Various sites in Naples and the surrounding province (list on the FAI website)

giro-giro-napoli-bambini.title: Giro Giro Napoli: free visits for children
giro-giro-napoli-bambini.blurb: Guided visits, workshops and activities for children every Saturday until 19 December.
giro-giro-napoli-bambini.place: Museums and cultural sites across Naples

gli-anni-capitolo-3-madre-2026.title: Gli anni. Capitolo 3 at the Museo Madre
gli-anni-capitolo-3-madre-2026.blurb: Works by Clemente, Pipilotti Rist, Kabakov, Fischli and others, each tied to the year it was first shown in Campania. The museum is closed on Tuesdays, and at weekends guided tours are included in the ticket.

halloween-tour-centro-antico-2026.title: Halloween night tour of the old town
halloween-tour-centro-antico-2026.blurb: A walk of almost two hours through dark legends, esotericism and ghost stories, with a horror finale and a drink in a bar in the centre. Fancy dress is welcome, and 15 to 17-year-olds pay €16.
halloween-tour-centro-antico-2026.place: Meeting point piazza Museo 19, in front of the MANN

homo-ridens-palapartenope-2026.title: Homo Ridens, Roberto Ciufoli's comedy show
homo-ridens-palapartenope-2026.blurb: Roberto Ciufoli brings to the Palapartenope a comedy show about the many sides of human nature, in Italian. An evening for anyone after a light laugh rather than heavyweight cabaret.

il-giovane-verdi-san-carlo-2026.title: Il giovane Verdi, the youthful Mass at the Teatro di San Carlo
il-giovane-verdi-san-carlo-2026.blurb: The San Carlo orchestra and chorus, conducted by Fabrizio Cassi, perform the Mass and sinfonias written by a Verdi barely out of his teens, in a critical edition. It lasts an hour and a half with an interval, and listening-only places cost €15.

il-medico-dei-pazzi-galleria-toledo-2026.title: Il medico dei pazzi by Scarpetta at Galleria Toledo
il-medico-dei-pazzi-galleria-toledo-2026.blurb: Laura Angiulli directs Eduardo Scarpetta's farce with Agostino Chiummariello and a large cast, sets by Rosario Squillace. Almost a month of performances, Fridays at 9pm and Sundays at 6pm.

il-nero-di-bagnoli-2026.title: Il Nero di Bagnoli, black truffle festival
il-nero-di-bagnoli-2026.blurb: The black truffle of Bagnoli Irpino, plus chestnuts, over two weekends, now in its 47th year. An hour and a half from Naples: you can combine it with Lake Laceno.

il-presidente-teatro-nuovo-2026.title: Il presidente with Filippo Nigro at the Teatro Nuovo
il-presidente-teatro-nuovo-2026.blurb: Fabrizio Arcuri and Filippo Nigro restage Davide Carnevali's play, rewritten for the occasion, with plenty of direct contact with the audience. Friday at 6.30pm, Saturday at 7pm, Sunday afternoon.

il-sosia-schubert-villa-pignatelli-2026.title: Il Sosia, the short life of Schubert at Villa Pignatelli
il-sosia-schubert-villa-pignatelli-2026.blurb: Piano four hands by Marco Schiavo and Sergio Marchegiani with Stefano Valanzuolo narrating, the life of Schubert told through music. A Sunday matinee for €10, booking required.

immacolata-concezione-bellini-2026.title: Immacolata Concezione by Vuccirìa Teatro at the Teatro Bellini
immacolata-concezione-bellini-2026.blurb: Joele Anastasi and the Sicilian company Vuccirìa stage three rituals about love, with Eduardo Scarpetta in the cast. On Wednesday there's a 5.30pm matinee; at the weekend it starts at 7pm on Saturday and 6pm on Sunday.

isgro-canto-napoli-capodimonte.title: Emilio Isgrò, “Canto Napoli” at Capodimonte
isgro-canto-napoli-capodimonte.blurb: Isgrò's famous erasures on twenty-five scores of Neapolitan songs. Closed on Wednesdays. Last two weeks.
isgro-canto-napoli-capodimonte.place: Museo e Real Bosco di Capodimonte

isolympia-belvedere-san-martino-2026.title: Isolympia, the games of Neapolis at the San Martino viewpoint
isolympia-belvedere-san-martino-2026.blurb: The ancient games founded by Augustus return as a festival of sport, dance, music and talks with a view over the bay. Take the Montesanto funicular up and stay on the viewpoint for sunset.

italian-urban-games-2026.title: Italian Urban Games, free urban sports in the city
italian-urban-games-2026.blurb: Four days of free urban sports, from skateboarding to parkour, organised by the City of Naples. All activities are free, and it's fine if you only want to watch. Check the timetable on the city council's website before heading out: it changes day by day.
italian-urban-games-2026.place: Naples, venues in the city council's programme

joseph-capriati-ex-base-nato-2026.title: Joseph Capriati celebrates twenty years on the decks at the ex Base Nato
joseph-capriati-ex-base-nato-2026.blurb: The best-known DJ from Caserta in the world comes home for a whole day of electronic music, from 2pm into the night, with international guests on the stage in Bagnoli.

kainrath-zilberstein-conservatorio-2026.title: Julian Kainrath and Lilya Zilberstein at the Conservatorio San Pietro a Majella
kainrath-zilberstein-conservatorio-2026.blurb: The young violinist Julian Kainrath and pianist Lilya Zilberstein play sonatas by Grieg, Brahms and Prokofiev, with pieces from Romeo and Juliet. Part of the Associazione Scarlatti season, €20.

kid-yugi-palapartenope-2026.title: Kid Yugi at the Teatro Palapartenope
kid-yugi-palapartenope-2026.blurb: The rapper from Puglia brings his platinum album Anche gli eroi muoiono to the indoor arenas. The Palapartenope is a short walk from the Edenlandia stop on the Cumana train, easy for getting home.

korper-al-nuovo-teatro-nuovo-2026.title: Körper al Nuovo, four nights of dance at the Teatro Nuovo
korper-al-nuovo-teatro-nuovo-2026.blurb: A dance season curated by Körper, with Compagnie Linga, Zappalà Danza 2, Luna Cenere's Shoes On and the young dancers of Körper Young. Watch the times: on Saturday 17th it starts at 7pm, on Sunday 18th at 6pm.

la-cara-dei-vecchi-piccolo-bellini-2026.title: La cara dei vecchi at the Piccolo Bellini
la-cara-dei-vecchi-piccolo-bellini-2026.blurb: A monologue by Elvira Buonocore performed by Anna Carla Broegg, directed by Pino Carbone with music by Antonio Maiuri and Marco Messina. On Tuesday and Wednesday tickets cost €15, from Thursday €20.

la-cenerentola-san-carlo-2026.title: La Cenerentola at the Teatro di San Carlo
la-cenerentola-san-carlo-2026.blurb: Damiano Michieletto's staging of Rossini's Cinderella returns, conducted by Speranza Scappucci, five performances between 20 and 27 October. You don't need to know the opera to enjoy it: the story is the fairy tale, only the costumes and pace change. Book the gallery if you're on a budget: the sound at the San Carlo carries everywhere.

la-mort-i-la-primavera-bellini-2026.title: La mort i la primavera by Marcos Morau and La Veronal at the Bellini
la-mort-i-la-primavera-bellini-2026.blurb: The Catalan company La Veronal turns Mercè Rodoreda's novel into dance, with Marcos Morau's striking choreography. Just three performances: Friday at 8.45pm, Saturday at 7pm, Sunday at 6pm.

la-vasca-bonaiuto-mercadante-2026.title: La vasca with Anna Bonaiuto at the Teatro Mercadante
la-vasca-bonaiuto-mercadante-2026.blurb: Anna Bonaiuto performs Franco Marcoaldi's play, directed by Andrea Renzi. There are several 5pm matinees, handy if you finish work in the centre.

lda-aka7even-casa-della-musica-2026.title: LDA and Aka7even at the Casa della Musica
lda-aka7even-casa-della-musica-2026.blurb: The duo behind Poesie clandestine play their joint album and hits from their own repertoires, with a few nods to Neapolitan song. One of three indoor dates this autumn.

legend-the-show-palapartenope-2026.title: Legend The Show, Michael Jackson with orchestra at the Teatro Palapartenope
legend-the-show-palapartenope-2026.blurb: A Michael Jackson show with live band, orchestra and dancers, led by Wendel Gama and with Jennifer Batten, the guitarist who actually played with him. A night out for families, it finishes around 11pm.

lisola-san-ferdinando-2026.title: L'isola with Cristina Donadio and Bianca Nappi at the Teatro San Ferdinando
lisola-san-ferdinando-2026.blurb: Two mothers in a hospital waiting room, forced to tell each other everything: Juan Carlos Rubio's play, directed by Marcello Cotugno. Saturday at 7pm, Sunday at 6pm, gallery seats from €13.

living-collapse-madre-2026.title: Living Collapse, the nativity scene through contemporary eyes at the Museo Madre
living-collapse-madre-2026.blurb: The second exhibition of the Premio Meridiana: three artists from Campania rethink the tradition of the presepe, the Neapolitan nativity scene, starting from Jimmie Durham's Presepio. It's covered by the same €8 ticket as the other exhibitions.

maccio-capatonda-bellini-2026.title: Maccio Capatonda's stage debut at the Bellini
maccio-capatonda-bellini-2026.blurb: A play about a play: a desperate theatre company talks the Italian comedian Maccio Capatonda into going on stage to save the theatre, with his alter ego appearing on video. Four nights and tickets go fast: the cheapest seats in the third tier start at €30 plus booking fee.

malika-ayane-augusteo-2026.title: Malika Ayane in concert at the Augusteo
malika-ayane-augusteo-2026.blurb: Malika Ayane in concert, with the voice and piano at the centre rather than big-tour effects. Prices are in line with other theatre concerts. Recommended for an intimate evening of music, not a stadium show.

mannight-15-ottobre-2026.title: MANNight, late opening at the Archaeological Museum
mannight-15-ottobre-2026.blurb: The MANN stays open late with live music, installations and performances among the archaeological galleries. After 7pm the ticket drops to ten euros, handy for a visit in a different atmosphere from usual.
mannight-15-ottobre-2026.place: MANN, Museo Archeologico Nazionale di Napoli

mannight-2026.title: MANNight
mannight-2026.blurb: On the four Thursdays in October the MANN, the National Archaeological Museum, stays open until 10.30pm with live music and contemporary art among the ancient statues. Go in the evening rather than by day: the rooms empty out and you see the works better.

mannight-22-ottobre-2026.title: MANNight, late opening at the Archaeological Museum
mannight-22-ottobre-2026.blurb: The MANN stays open late with live music, installations and performances among the archaeological galleries. After 7pm the ticket drops to ten euros, handy for a visit in a different atmosphere from usual.

mannight-26-settembre-1-euro.title: MANNight for €1 for the European Heritage Days
mannight-26-settembre-1-euro.blurb: A special evening in the series of late openings at the MANN, the National Archaeological Museum: music, dance and installations among the collections, for a token ticket.

mannight-8-ottobre-2026.title: MANNight, late opening at the Archaeological Museum
mannight-8-ottobre-2026.blurb: The MANN stays open late with live music, installations and performances among the archaeological galleries. After 7pm the ticket drops to ten euros, handy for a visit in a different atmosphere from usual.

maradona-lo-spettacolo-palapartenope-202.title: Maradona, the show at the Teatro Palapartenope
maradona-lo-spettacolo-palapartenope-202.blurb: The story of Diego in Naples on stage, with music and storytelling, in the Fuorigrotta theatre a short walk from the stadium that bears his name.

marco-masini-palapartenope-2026.title: Marco Masini in concert at the Palapartenope
marco-masini-palapartenope-2026.blurb: The Italian singer Marco Masini in concert at the Palapartenope, a date on his autumn tour with the classics in the setlist. If you fancy singing along to 90s Italian pop, this is your night.

mare-di-ruggine-la-favola-dell-ilva-2026.title: Mare di ruggine. La favola dell’Ilva
mare-di-ruggine-la-favola-dell-ilva-2026.blurb: Political theatre that tells the story of Taranto and its Ilva steelworks as a fable: eighty minutes with no interval in the Bellini's small hall. In Italian. Book ahead: there aren't many seats and shows like this often sell out.

maria-lai-madre.title: Maria Lai, “Essere è tessere” at the Madre
maria-lai-madre.blurb: Sixty years of threads, fabrics and stitched books: the most complete retrospective of her work the city has seen. Open until 8pm on Sundays, closed on Tuesdays.

mastelloni-solo-tiny-sannazaro-2026.title: Leopoldo Mastelloni tells Mastelloni at the Teatro TINy Sannazaro
mastelloni-solo-tiny-sannazaro-2026.blurb: Alone on stage, Leopoldo Mastelloni revisits the characters of a career spanning Eduardo, Viviani and Patroni Griffi. A small room with few seats, Saturday at 7pm and Sunday at 6pm.

mavi-teatro-augusteo-2026.title: Mavi in concert at the Augusteo
mavi-teatro-augusteo-2026.blurb: Mavi in concert at the Teatro Augusteo, with several price bands from the gallery to the front stalls (poltronissima). For the best view, book the poltronissima a little ahead: it tends to sell out first.

mercatino-posillipo-giovedi-2026-10-01.title: Posillipo street market, Thursday mornings by the Parco Virgiliano
mercatino-posillipo-giovedi-2026-10-01.blurb: On Thursdays viale Virgilio is lined with stalls selling clothes, including end-of-line designer pieces, bags, homeware and plants. After a wander, head up into the Parco Virgiliano for the view over Nisida and Capri.
mercatino-posillipo-giovedi-2026-10-01.place: Viale Virgilio, at the entrance to the Parco Virgiliano

mercatino-posillipo-giovedi-2026-10-29.blurb: On Thursdays viale Virgilio is lined with stalls selling clothes, including end-of-line designer pieces, bags, homeware and plants. After a wander, head up into the Parco Virgiliano for the view over Nisida and Capri.

mercato-antiquariato-ippodromo-agnano-20.blurb: More than two hundred stalls across the racecourse grounds: period furniture, records, postcards, silverware, second-hand clothes and plenty to rummage through. Parking is free and the good pieces are gone by 9am, so go early and bring cash.
mercato-antiquariato-ippodromo-agnano-20.place: Ippodromo di Agnano (Agnano racecourse), via Raffaele Ruggiero

mercato-della-terra-boscoreale-2026-10-1.title: Slow Food Mercato della Terra in Boscoreale, in piazza Vargas
mercato-della-terra-boscoreale-2026-10-1.blurb: Farmers from the villages around Vesuvius bring piennolo tomatoes, wine, pulses, olive oil and fruit to the square, with a workshop on the product of the month at around 11am. You get there on the Circumvesuviana local train and, if you have time, you can pair it with a visit to Villa Regina and the Antiquarium.

mercato-della-terra-boscoreale-2026-11-0.title: Slow Food Mercato della Terra in Boscoreale, in piazza Vargas
mercato-della-terra-boscoreale-2026-11-0.blurb: Farmers from the villages around Vesuvius bring piennolo tomatoes, wine, pulses, olive oil and fruit to the square, with a workshop on the product of the month at around 11am. mercato-della-terra-piano-di-sorrento-20.title: Slow Food Mercato della Terra in Piano di Sorrento, second Sunday of the month
mercato-della-terra-piano-di-sorrento-20.blurb: Under the Art Nouveau iron canopy of the town’s covered market, only small producers from the Sorrento peninsula sell bread, olive oil, cheese, eggs, preserves and vegetables picked the day before. At 11am there is a free tasting workshop on the product of the month, and it is worth staying for.
mercato-della-terra-piano-di-sorrento-20.place: Covered market in piazza della Repubblica

mercato-della-terra-piano-di-sorrento-20.title: Slow Food Mercato della Terra in Piano di Sorrento, second Sunday of the month

mozart-haydn-porta-del-parco-2026.title: Mozart and Papa Haydn at the Auditorium Porta del Parco
mozart-haydn-porta-del-parco-2026.blurb: The string quartet Musica Nova à Quattro plays Haydn and Mozart's Quartet in D minor. A Saturday afternoon concert, the last October date of the Musica Urbana series.

musica-urbana-ramin-bahrami-bagnoli-2026.title: Ramin Bahrami opens Musica Urbana at the Bagnoli Auditorium
musica-urbana-ramin-bahrami-bagnoli-2026.blurb: The Bach pianist par excellence plays two Partitas and opens a classical music series on the city's edge. Under-30s pay €5, tickets on Azzurroservice.
musica-urbana-ramin-bahrami-bagnoli-2026.place: Auditorium Porta del Parco, via Diocleziano 341

napoli-cuba-solo-andata-conservatorio-20.title: Napoli Cuba solo andata at the Conservatorio di San Pietro a Majella
napoli-cuba-solo-andata-conservatorio-20.blurb: Latin jazz with Giulio Martino, Marco Sannini and Giovanni Imparato on percussion, joined by students from the jazz course. Entry is free until places run out, in the Conservatorio's finest hall, so arrive early.
napoli-cuba-solo-andata-conservatorio-20.place: Sala Scarlatti, Conservatorio San Pietro a Majella, via San Pietro a Majella 35

nayt-noi-individui-tour-2026.title: Nayt, Noi Individui Tour at the Palapartenope
nayt-noi-individui-tour-2026.blurb: The Italian rapper Nayt returns to the Palapartenope with his tour, one of the most awaited rap gigs of the autumn in the city. The venue is big: if you want to be near the stage, go for the floor (arena) tickets.

nazra-palestine-film-festival-2026.title: Nazra Palestine Short Film Festival, Naples leg
nazra-palestine-film-festival-2026.blurb: Three evenings of Palestinian short films between San Giorgio a Cremano, the Vomero and Arenella, free entry. The closing night is on 4 October at the Cinema Vittoria. Good if you're after films you won't find in the usual cinema listings.
nazra-palestine-film-festival-2026.place: MAV, CasaCinema Napoli and Cinema Vittoria
nazra-palestine-film-festival-2026.area: San Giorgio a Cremano, Vomero, Arenella

neanche-parenti-piccolo-bellini-2026.title: Neanche parenti at the Piccolo Bellini
neanche-parenti-piccolo-bellini-2026.blurb: A new play written and directed by Gabriele Russo and Arianna D'Angiò, running for almost a month in the Bellini's small studio theatre. Tickets are cheaper on Tuesdays and Wednesdays, and on Sundays it starts at 6.30pm.

neapolis-marathon-2026.title: Neapolis Marathon
neapolis-marathon-2026.blurb: Three days of running events in the city, with the marathon as the centrepiece of the weekend. Even if you're not running, bear it in mind if you're passing through: several streets in the centre change their traffic arrangements during the race.

neapolis-sea-run-2026.title: Neapolis Sea Run, from Piazza del Plebiscito
neapolis-sea-run-2026.blurb: Twelve kilometres of non-competitive walking or running, starting from Piazza del Plebiscito. You need an Italian non-competitive sports medical certificate, so it's not a last-minute thing. A good way to cross the city on foot with a race number rather than dodging cars.

note-d-autunno-capodimonte-2026.title: Note d’autunno, free concerts in the Ballroom at Capodimonte
note-d-autunno-capodimonte-2026.blurb: A series of free concerts by the Ensemble Mercadante in the Ballroom of the royal palace, included in the museum ticket. It opens with a preview on 26 September and carries on with four more dates until the end of October.
note-d-autunno-capodimonte-2026.time: preview at 8pm on 26 September, then 5pm on 10, 18, 25 and 31 October
note-d-autunno-capodimonte-2026.place: Real Bosco di Capodimonte, Sala da Ballo

notte-halloween-zattera-galleria-borboni.title: Halloween night by raft in the Galleria Borbonica
notte-halloween-zattera-galleria-borboni.blurb: You go down into the Galleria Borbonica and float by raft across the underground cistern, with a Halloween atmosphere, on two nights. Ages 10 and up, booking required. Bring a jacket: it's colder underground than in the street.

oktober-festival-edenlandia-2026.title: Oktober Festival at Edenlandia, final weekend
oktober-festival-edenlandia-2026.blurb: Bavarian beer, German food and vintage fairground rides, with live Neapolitan music under the big tent in the evening. Entry to the park is free with an online ticket; the tent with the shows costs €10.

oktoberdays-palapartenope-2-2026.title: OktoberDays at the Palapartenope, second weekend
oktoberdays-palapartenope-2-2026.blurb: Round two of the Bavarian beer festival in Fuorigrotta: Erdinger beer, long tables and shows indoors, rides and food outside, and an area for children. Four days, Thursday to Sunday.

omaggio-battiato-villa-pignatelli-2026.title: A tribute to Franco Battiato at Villa Pignatelli
omaggio-battiato-villa-pignatelli-2026.blurb: Quartetto d'Arti, with voice, violin, cello and guitars, plays the songs of the much-loved Italian songwriter Franco Battiato in the concert Perché sei un essere speciale. It's on a Sunday morning, so afterwards you can wander down for a stroll in the Villa Comunale park.

open-house-napoli-2026.title: Open House Napoli, the city opens its doors
open-house-napoli-2026.blurb: A weekend when more than 150 places normally closed to the public open their doors for free, from the Old Town to the Campi Flegrei. Booking for the most popular ones opens on 25 September, so note down the ones you want straight away. The easiest way to see the parts of Naples that usually stay behind a gate.
open-house-napoli-2026.place: More than 150 places between the Old Town and the Campi Flegrei

oren-nona-beethoven-san-carlo-2026.title: Beethoven's Ninth conducted by Daniel Oren at the Teatro di San Carlo
oren-nona-beethoven-san-carlo-2026.blurb: Daniel Oren on the podium, with the theatre's orchestra and chorus and four soloists including Michele Pertusi, for Symphony No. 9, Ode to Joy and all. Seventy-five minutes without an interval and only two nights, so book early.

organo-in-scena-conservatorio-2026.title: L'organo in scena, Monday organ concerts at the Conservatorio San Pietro a Majella
organo-in-scena-conservatorio-2026.blurb: Six Mondays with different organists for the Conservatory's bicentenary, from Napoli è porosa on 5 October until mid-December. Free entry; the October and November dates are 5, 12 and 26 October and 9 and 23 November.
organo-in-scena-conservatorio-2026.place: Conservatorio San Pietro a Majella, Sala Scarlatti

ornella-vanoni-pacifico-bellini-2026.title: Diario sentimentale di una donna libera, at the Bellini
ornella-vanoni-pacifico-bellini-2026.blurb: The songwriter Pacifico tells the story of Ornella Vanoni through the songs he wrote for her, more a diary than a tribute. On at the Bellini from 20 to 25 October, in Italian. Best for those who already know Vanoni and want to hear her story from someone who worked with her.

otello-diana-2026.title: Otello with Giacomo Giorgio and Giorgio Pasotti at the Teatro Diana
otello-diana-2026.blurb: Giacomo Giorgio, known from the TV series Mare fuori, plays Othello, and Giorgio Pasotti directs a script by Dacia Maraini. On Saturdays there are two shows, at 5.30pm and 9pm.

ozpetek-ruoli-secondari-diana-2026.title: Ruoli secondari by Ferzan Ozpetek at the Teatro Diana
ozpetek-ruoli-secondari-diana-2026.blurb: The new show written and directed by Ferzan Ozpetek, after bringing his films Mine vaganti and Magnifica presenza to the stage. On Saturdays choose between 5.30pm and 9pm, on Sundays it's 6pm.

palazzo-reale-apertura-serale-2-ottobre-.title: Late opening at the Palazzo Reale with stargazing from the Belvedere
palazzo-reale-apertura-serale-2-ottobre-.blurb: The Palazzo Reale stays open until midnight for €5, and for another €5 you can go up to the Belvedere and look at the sky through the telescopes of the Capodimonte Observatory. The same evening Villa Pignatelli is open until 11.30pm for €3.

parthenope-market-santissima-settembre-2.title: Parthenope Market at La Santissima, vintage and makers in the Quartieri Spagnoli
parthenope-market-santissima-settembre-2.blurb: Stalls of vintage clothes, vinyl, handmade jewellery and small Neapolitan makers, inside the former Trinità delle Monache convent complex, with music all day. Come in the morning: entry is free until 2pm and the best pieces are still there.
parthenope-market-santissima-settembre-2.place: La Santissima Community Hub, vico Trinità delle Monache

peppe-barra-buonasera-sannazaro-2026.title: Peppe Barra in Buonasera a tutti at the Teatro Sannazaro
peppe-barra-buonasera-sannazaro-2026.blurb: A recital by Peppe Barra mixing songs, stories and masks, talking straight to the audience. Three nights on via Chiaia, and on Sunday it starts at 6pm.

pessoa-luna-park-castel-sant-elmo-2026.title: Pessoa Luna Park in the moat of Castel Sant’Elmo
pessoa-luna-park-castel-sant-elmo-2026.blurb: The castle moat is open to the public for the first time, Thursday to Sunday from 5.30pm to half past midnight: gigs and DJ sets, open-air cinema, theatre, games, chess and long shared tables. Until 4 October.
pessoa-luna-park-castel-sant-elmo-2026.place: Fossato di Castel Sant’Elmo, via Tito Angelini 20/A

philip-colbert-pompei.title: Philip Colbert at Pompeii
philip-colbert-pompei.blurb: Colbert's pop lobsters among the Roman houses, during normal opening hours. They split opinion: some find them brilliant, others out of place. Making up your own mind costs nothing extra.

pieranunzi-bill-evans-villa-di-donato-20.title: Enrico Pieranunzi plays Bill Evans at Villa di Donato
pieranunzi-bill-evans-villa-di-donato-20.blurb: One of the great European jazz pianists pays tribute to Bill Evans in the salon of an 18th-century villa, with cocktails before the concert. Places are limited, so call or email the villa to book.

pinocchio-iodice-trianon-2026.title: Pinocchio, che cos'è una persona? by Davide Iodice at the Teatro Trianon Viviani
pinocchio-iodice-trianon-2026.blurb: The show by Davide Iodice's Scuola elementare del teatro, winner of a special Ubu award (Italy's top theatre prize), with disabled and non-disabled actors. Friday and Saturday at 9pm, Sunday at 6pm.

premio-carosone-arena-flegrea-2026.title: Premio Carosone at the Arena Flegrea
premio-carosone-arena-flegrea-2026.blurb: A free evening in memory of Renato Carosone, with Gigi D’Alessio, Gigi Finizio, Enzo Gragnaniello and other names from Neapolitan song on the same stage. Book on ETES: with a line-up like this the places go fast. Well worth it if you love Neapolitan song and want to hear it live without spending a cent.

progetto-cuccagna-tombe-virgilio-2026.title: “Progetto Cuccagna” at the park of Virgil's and Leopardi's tombs
progetto-cuccagna-tombe-virgilio-2026.blurb: Theatre in the park that holds the tombs of Virgil and the poet Giacomo Leopardi, part of the «Metamorfosi Campane» season run by the regional museums office. At 6pm, free entry with booking.

raiz-love-songs-conservatorio-2026.title: Raiz and IDR, Love Songs at the Conservatorio San Pietro a Majella
raiz-love-songs-conservatorio-2026.blurb: The voice of Almamegretta teams up with the New York ensemble of Marco Cappelli and Jim Pugliese for Neapolitan love songs, from the old repertoire to today, in a world premiere. Part of the Associazione Scarlatti season, €20.

ricordando-severino-canino-conservatorio.title: Ricordando Severino: Bruno Canino and Salvatore Lombardi at the Conservatorio
ricordando-severino-canino-conservatorio.blurb: A tribute to the flautist Severino Gazzelloni, with Salvatore Lombardi on flute and the veteran Bruno Canino at the piano, playing Marcello, Mozart and Donizetti. Free entry until places run out.
ricordando-severino-canino-conservatorio.place: Sala Scarlatti, Conservatorio San Pietro a Majella, via San Pietro a Majella 35

romeo-juliet-project-piccolo-bellini-202.title: Romeo & Juliet project by Lindsay Kemp at the Piccolo Bellini
romeo-juliet-project-piccolo-bellini-202.blurb: The dancers of Borderlinedanza, led by Daniela Maccari, revive Lindsay Kemp's dance theatre to music by Nino Rota, Purcell and Puccini. Just three nights in the small hall: Saturday starts at 7.30pm, Sunday at 6.30pm.

sagra-castagna-fungo-porcino-roccamonfin.title: Chestnut and porcini festival in Roccamonfina
sagra-castagna-fungo-porcino-roccamonfin.blurb: Every weekend in October on the extinct volcano in the Caserta countryside: Roccamonfina's PGI chestnuts, porcini and other produce from the woods. Check the dates on the Pro Loco's page before setting off.

sagra-castagna-nocciola-avella-2026.title: Chestnut and hazelnut festival in Avella
sagra-castagna-nocciola-avella-2026.blurb: Chestnuts and hazelnuts from Avella, the area that gave the hazelnut its Latin name, over two weekends at the end of October. It's the closest of these festivals to Naples: about 45 minutes.

sagra-castagna-serino-2026.title: Serino chestnut festival (Sagra della Castagna)
sagra-castagna-serino-2026.blurb: Serino's PGI chestnuts in a mountain hamlet, now in its 49th year, with free shuttles from the valley floor. About an hour from Naples.

sagra-dei-funghi-cusano-mutri-2026.title: Mushroom festival (Sagra dei Funghi) in Cusano Mutri
sagra-dei-funghi-cusano-mutri-2026.blurb: The biggest food festival in the Matese mountains, now in its 46th year: porcini cooked every way you can think of, in the lanes of a medieval village. Weekends get crowded: book parking and take the shuttle, and aim to arrive for lunch.

sal-da-vinci-arena-flegrea.title: Sal Da Vinci, “Napoli, per sempre sì”
sal-da-vinci-arena-flegrea.blurb: Three nights at the Arena Flegrea to mark fifty years since the Neapolitan singer's debut: 25, 26 and 27 September, the third date added after the first two sold out.

scuola-napoletana-russia-san-carlo-2026.title: La Scuola Napoletana in Russia, chamber music at the Teatro di San Carlo
scuola-napoletana-russia-san-carlo-2026.blurb: An hour of arias and capriccios by Paisiello, Araja and Sebastiani, the Neapolitan composers the 18th century took to the court of St Petersburg, with the orchestra's musicians and the Academy's singers. One price of €18 in every section, so go for the stalls.

se-io-fossi-federico-salvatore-2026.title: Se io fossi Federico Salvatore, charity concert
se-io-fossi-federico-salvatore-2026.blurb: A tribute concert to the Neapolitan singer and comedian Federico Salvatore, with the proceeds going to charity: an evening of Neapolitan songs and humour at the Augusteo. A good choice if you want live music and a good cause in one go.

serafino-gubbio-ridotto-mercadante-2026.title: Quaderni di Serafino Gubbio operatore at the Ridotto del Mercadante
serafino-gubbio-ridotto-mercadante-2026.blurb: Flavio Capuzzo Dolcetta adapts Pirandello's novel about cinema and the man reduced to turning a camera handle, in the Ridotto's intimate studio. Saturday at 7pm, Sunday at 6pm.

serate-nella-grande-pompei-2026.title: Pompeii by night: the excavations open after dark
serate-nella-grande-pompei-2026.blurb: Every Friday and Saturday until 10 October the park's sites open from 7.30pm to 11.30pm. At Pompeii there are two routes: from the Amphitheatre, taking in the body casts at the Great Palestra and the house of Julia Felix, on 19 and 26 September and 10 October; or the Villa of the Mysteries, with a shuttle to Villa Regina in Boscoreale. The walks at Villa San Marco and Villa Arianna are free.
serate-nella-grande-pompei-2026.place: Parco Archeologico di Pompei and partner sites

serena-rossi-serenata-diana-2026.title: Serena Rossi in Serenata a Napoli at the Teatro Diana
serena-rossi-serenata-diana-2026.blurb: Serena Rossi tells and sings Naples as a siren and a female city, in a show directed by Cristina Redini. Three weeks of performances, with matinees on Wednesdays at 5.45pm and Sundays at 6pm.

social-park-parco-del-poggio-2026.title: Social Park vol. III at Parco del Poggio: the last Sunday in the park
social-park-parco-del-poggio-2026.blurb: Third and final Sunday of Social Park: DJ sets from BUSEX, ITALOMARIO and OKAMI, food and drinks, a small market, a fitness area, a space for children and one for dogs, from 6pm to midnight. Free entry with booking.
social-park-parco-del-poggio-2026.place: Parco del Poggio, viale Poggio di Capodimonte 53

solisti-aquilani-sciortino-conservatorio.title: I Solisti Aquilani and Orazio Sciortino at the Conservatorio San Pietro a Majella
solisti-aquilani-sciortino-conservatorio.blurb: Orazio Sciortino plays and conducts Mozart's Piano Concerto K 449, then the orchestra takes on Schoenberg's Verklärte Nacht (Transfigured Night). Single tickets are €20 at the box office before the concert.

spinacorona-anteprima-carmine-2026.title: Spinacorona preview: Beethoven's First Symphony at the Carmine
spinacorona-anteprima-carmine-2026.blurb: The Orchestra della Toscana and pianist Michele Campanella open the tenth Spinacorona with Beethoven's First Symphony and Triple Concerto. There's no booking: doors open half an hour before, so arrive early if you want a seat.
spinacorona-anteprima-carmine-2026.place: Basilica del Carmine Maggiore, piazza del Carmine

spinacorona-passeggiate-musicali-2026.title: Spinacorona: ten free Beethoven concerts in the old town
spinacorona-passeggiate-musicali-2026.blurb: Three days of musical walks all devoted to Beethoven, from a piano in San Giovanni a Mare to the Diabelli Variations at the Trinità dei Pellegrini. Pick two or three stops close together and stroll between concerts; doors open half an hour before each one.
spinacorona-passeggiate-musicali-2026.place: Churches and palazzi of the old town, from San Giovanni a Mare to the SS. Annunziata

tavola-rotonda-cavalier-bideri-conservat.title: Neapolitan song and the publisher Bideri at the Conservatorio
tavola-rotonda-cavalier-bideri-conservat.blurb: A concert tells the story of the golden age of Neapolitan song through the publisher Bideri, with a soprano, a singer and the Conservatorio ensemble. Free entry, and seats fill up fast.
tavola-rotonda-cavalier-bideri-conservat.place: Sala Scarlatti, Conservatorio San Pietro a Majella, via San Pietro a Majella 35

teardo-bargeld-trianon-2026.title: Teho Teardo and Blixa Bargeld in concert at the Teatro Trianon Viviani
teardo-bargeld-trianon-2026.blurb: The composer Teho Teardo and the voice of Einstürzende Neubauten, who also played with Nick Cave, perform together with strings, electronics and song. A single date in Forcella, tickets on Vivaticket.

terme-suburbane-ercolano-visite-2026.title: Suburban Baths of Herculaneum: guided tours of the restoration site
terme-suburbane-ercolano-visite-2026.blurb: Every Saturday groups of 15 put on hard hats and go into the Roman baths overlooking the ancient beach, normally closed to the public. The ticket includes the excavations too, and under-18s go free.
terme-suburbane-ercolano-visite-2026.place: Parco Archeologico di Ercolano, corso Resina 187

tesoro-san-gennaro-serata-novembre-2026.title: Un Tesoro di serata: after-hours tour of the Treasure of San Gennaro
tesoro-san-gennaro-serata-novembre-2026.blurb: The second autumn evening to see the gifts to the saint and the sacristies without the daytime crowds, finishing with an aperitivo in the courtyard. Book a few weeks ahead, as the groups are small.
tesoro-san-gennaro-serata-novembre-2026.place: Museo del Tesoro di San Gennaro, via Duomo 149

tesoro-san-gennaro-serata-ottobre-2026.title: Un Tesoro di serata: after-hours tour of the Treasure of San Gennaro
tesoro-san-gennaro-serata-ottobre-2026.blurb: With the museum closed, a guide takes you past the mitre, the necklace of San Gennaro, the Royal Chapel and Mimmo Jodice's photographs, followed by an aperitivo in the courtyard. Places are few and booking is only on the website; children up to 12 go free.
tesoro-san-gennaro-serata-ottobre-2026.place: Museo del Tesoro di San Gennaro, via Duomo 149

tour-del-giallo-piazza-mercato-2026.title: Tour del Giallo at Piazza Mercato: wartime crimes
tour-del-giallo-piazza-mercato-2026.blurb: The leg of the Tour del Giallo, a series of crime-fiction walks, devoted to the Second World War years, between the Carmine and the port. Saturday and Sunday at 10am, free, booking by email to redazione@gialli.it.

tour-del-giallo-vomero-2026.title: Tour del Giallo in the Vomero, in the places of Maurizio de Giovanni
tour-del-giallo-vomero-2026.blurb: The last leg of the Tour del Giallo crime-fiction walks follows the novels of Maurizio de Giovanni through the streets of the Vomero. Saturday and Sunday at 10am, free, booking by email to redazione@gialli.it.

tour-quartieri-spagnoli-insolitaguida-sa.title: Quartieri Spagnoli walking tour with Insolitaguida: murals, street shrines, wine and cuoppo
tour-quartieri-spagnoli-insolitaguida-sa.blurb: A two-hour walk from the little square by Pizzeria Brandi to the Pignasecca market, past the Maradona mural, vico Totò and the neighbourhood’s street shrines. The price includes a coffee, a cuoppo (a paper cone of fried snacks) and a glass of red, so go easy on breakfast.
tour-quartieri-spagnoli-insolitaguida-sa.place: Quartieri Spagnoli, meeting point given when you book

tour-rione-sanita-insolitaguida-domenica.blurb: Two hours on foot taking in Palazzo dello Spagnolo, Palazzo San Felice, the Borgo dei Vergini and the basilica of Santa Maria della Sanità, with a coffee and a fiocco di neve (a cream-filled brioche) from Poppella included. Wear comfortable shoes and book a few days ahead, as the groups fill up.
tour-rione-sanita-insolitaguida-domenica.place: Meeting point at Porta San Gennaro

trianondanza-2026.title: TrianonDanza 2026 at the Teatro Trianon Viviani
trianondanza-2026.blurb: A contemporary dance season with companies from Campania, from Gabriella Stazio to Körper Young and Fabrizio Varriale, almost every night until mid-October. One price of €5 for everything, so you can take a chance on a name you've never heard of.

trio-hermes-barbieri-chiesa-anglicana-20.title: Trio Hermes and Guido Barbieri on Goya and Beethoven at the Anglican Church
trio-hermes-barbieri-chiesa-anglicana-20.blurb: Violin, cello and piano, with Guido Barbieri telling the parallel lives of Goya and Beethoven. The church on via San Pasquale has warm, intimate acoustics, €20.

txt-festival-mercadante-2026.title: TXT Festival with Martin Crimp at the Mercadante and San Ferdinando
txt-festival-mercadante-2026.blurb: Four days of European playwriting with Martin Crimp as guest: readings, his opera Written on Skin, shows in the Ridotto studio and, after midnight, DJ sets and after-show parties with free entry. Check the programme night by night, as some tickets cover two shows back to back.
txt-festival-mercadante-2026.place: Teatro Mercadante and Teatro San Ferdinando

ultimo-nastro-krapp-mercadante-2026.title: L'ultimo nastro di Krapp and Press Conference with Renato Carpentieri at the Mercadante
ultimo-nastro-krapp-mercadante-2026.blurb: Roberto Andò pairs Beckett and Pinter in a double bill about memory and power, carried entirely by Renato Carpentieri. On weekdays the side boxes cost €13, and there are 5pm matinees.

uri-caine-villa-pignatelli-2026.title: Uri Caine solo piano at Villa Pignatelli
uri-caine-villa-pignatelli-2026.blurb: The American pianist Uri Caine plays solo, with a programme called Change, moving between jazz and new takes on the classics. An evening with 199 seats, reduced to €15 for over-65s and under-26s.

us-navy-top-brass-conservatorio-2026.title: Top Brass, the US Navy band's quintet at the Conservatorio
us-navy-top-brass-conservatorio-2026.blurb: The brass quintet of the US Naval Forces in Europe plays swing, marches and modern arrangements in the Conservatorio's hall. An hour of light, well-played music, with free entry.
us-navy-top-brass-conservatorio-2026.place: Sala Scarlatti, Conservatorio San Pietro a Majella, via San Pietro a Majella 35

uscita-di-emergenza-san-ferdinando-2026.title: Uscita di emergenza by Santanelli at the Teatro San Ferdinando
uscita-di-emergenza-san-ferdinando-2026.blurb: Vincenzo Ferrera and Nando Paone in Manlio Santanelli's classic about two men stuck in a crumbling house after the earthquake. Seats up in the gallery start at €13 on weekdays.

vendemmiamo-la-catalanesca-2026.title: Harvesting Catalanesca: picking, tasting and lunch in the vineyard
vendemmiamo-la-catalanesca-2026.blurb: A day as a grape picker on the side of Vesuvius where Catalanesca grows, a grape once used only for eating and now made into wine: picking in the morning, then a tasting and lunch among the vines.

venere-vs-adone-trianon-2026.title: Venere vs Adone by Enzo Cosimi at the Teatro Trianon Viviani
venere-vs-adone-trianon-2026.blurb: Dance theatre by Enzo Cosimi that moves through a world of images from Andy Warhol to Marlene Dumas. Saturday at 9pm, Sunday at 6pm.

vespero-napoletano-2026.title: Vespero Napoletano, the slow tourism festival
vespero-napoletano-2026.blurb: Walks, workshops, concerts and roving performances put on by the City of Naples, every weekend until 24 October.

videomapping-castel-dell-ovo-2026.title: Projection mapping on Castel dell'Ovo for the America's Cup finale
videomapping-castel-dell-ovo-2026.blurb: After the regatta prize-giving at the Rotonda Diaz, the castle's façade lights up with three minutes of projections on the history of Naples and the sea. Find a spot on the seafront facing Megaride a few minutes early, as the show is short.

vinicio-capossela-augusteo-2026.title: Vinicio Capossela, “E morte non avrà dominio”, at the Augusteo
vinicio-capossela-augusteo-2026.blurb: Capossela brings his new concert-and-theatre show to the Augusteo, part songs, part spoken word. Don't expect a fixed setlist: it changes every night. Go if you like his darker side, the one from his latest albums.

voyageur-ibrahim-mahama-piazza-municipio.title: Voyageur, Ibrahim Mahama's three boats in piazza Municipio
voyageur-ibrahim-mahama-piazza-municipio.blurb: Three wooden boats built in Ghana, up to 8 metres high, rise out of the paving in front of the port like shipwrecks. Stop by at sunset as you come out of Municipio metro station; you can walk all the way round them.

willie-peyote-casa-della-musica-2026.title: Willie Peyote in concert at the Casa della Musica
willie-peyote-casa-della-musica-2026.blurb: The Italian rapper Willie Peyote in club format at the Casa della Musica, a smaller space closer to the stage than the Palapartenope arena itself. A good pick if you prefer gigs in intimate venues to big arenas.

wine-spot-scavi-ercolano-17-ottobre-2026.title: Wine Spot agli Scavi: a second night of wine and jazz at Herculaneum
wine-spot-scavi-ercolano-17-ottobre-2026.blurb: A repeat of the night walk among the Roman houses, glass in hand, with live music. There are 650 places each evening, so buy your ticket on CoopCulture before you set off.
wine-spot-scavi-ercolano-17-ottobre-2026.place: Parco Archeologico di Ercolano, corso Resina 187

wine-spot-scavi-ercolano-3-ottobre-2026.title: Wine Spot agli Scavi: Herculaneum by night with wine and jazz
wine-spot-scavi-ercolano-3-ottobre-2026.blurb: The excavations stay open in the evening with the Roman houses lit up, tastings of Vesuvius wines led by sommeliers and an acoustic jazz set. Bring a light jacket; under-12s go free.
wine-spot-scavi-ercolano-3-ottobre-2026.place: Parco Archeologico di Ercolano, corso Resina 187

yunchan-lim-san-carlo-2026.title: Yunchan Lim in recital at the San Carlo
yunchan-lim-san-carlo-2026.blurb: The South Korean pianist who won the Van Cliburn at eighteen plays Mozart at the San Carlo, one concert only on 12 October. Go if you like the piano up close, with no orchestra to cover the detail. Gallery seats are there for anyone who just wants to listen without spending a lot.
